title: Viva Insights: Agent 365 Dashboard view in the Copilot Analytics Agent Dashboard
summary: Hold for two access-governance corrections. Global Administrators do not necessarily receive dashboard access in PIM-enabled tenants, and user or group policies take precedence over tenant policies rather than the most restrictive setting always winning across scopes.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: Qualifying senior leaders receive automatic access in tenants with a main reporting line and at least 2,500 Entra ID users.
claims.quote: Users who are senior leaders within large teams ... can automatically view the report. ... The majority of users in the tenant are part of a single reporting line ... The tenant has at least 2,500 users with an Entra ID

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Users holding the Global administrator role have automatic Agent Dashboard access without qualification.
claims.quote: If you're a Privileged Identity Management (PIM) enabled tenant, global admins might not have access to the Agent Dashboard. If you want to give global admins access to the Agent Dashboard, add them explicitly using these steps.
claims.fix: Qualify the Global Administrator access statement: 'In PIM-enabled tenants, Global Administrators might not have access; add them explicitly through the documented Viva Insights web app access settings if they need access.' Keep the At rollout instruction to check actual access rather than assuming it was granted.

claims.claim: Enabled managers can access the Agent Dashboard.
claims.quote: Enabled managers who already have team-level access to Copilot Analytics in Viva Insights can also access the dashboard. Managers can see agent insights scoped to the teams they're enabled to view.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; rationale: impact

claims.claim: Users with dashboard access can delegate access to others in their company.
claims.quote: If you have access to the Agent Dashboard, you can also delegate access to the dashboard to other people in your company.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The Agent 365 view lists named agents with sessions and active users.
claims.quote: You can view and search the list of the top agents used in your organization ... based on the agent name ... Agent 365 Dashboard metrics include sessions, the number of active users, and the change in active users.

claims.claim: Activity can be broken down by group, organization and job function.
claims.quote: The Job function filter only appears if your Insights admin uploads a .csv file with the organizational data attribute of FunctionType or your Global admin uploads a .csv file with the organizational data attribute of JobDiscipline.
claims.fix: Qualify the sentence with: 'Job-function reporting requires uploaded organizational job-function attributes.' The capability is documented, but it is not populated automatically from Entra ID.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: impact

claims.quote: The analyzed population in the Agent Dashboard includes all employees who have had agent activity.

claims.claim: Minimum group size suppresses agent names and group metrics for smaller groups.
claims.quote: To protect individual privacy, agent names and group metrics aren't shown for groups that are smaller than the minimum group size.

claims.claim: Minimum group size defaults to 10 employees.
claims.quote: The dashboards' adoption and impact pages provide group-level metrics for groups that meet or exceed the minimum group size you set, which by default is 10 employees.

claims.claim: Minimum group size cannot be configured below five.
claims.quote: Enter your preferred minimum group size, which must be at least five, then select Save.

claims.claim: Both the web app and Agent Dashboard controls must be enabled for access, so either can remove dashboard access.
claims.quote: Turning this control off disables the Agent Dashboard. To access the Agent Dashboard, both the Viva Insights web app control and this control must be enabled.

claims.claim: The Agent Dashboard Learn page describes reporting interactions but no action taken on agents from the dashboard.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Agent Dashboard" "actions" "agents" "Viva Insights"'; read the full Connect to the Agent Dashboard page, including Key actions users can take and Agent deep dive pages; these describe viewing, filters and metrics, not agent modification.

claims.where: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: The Agent Dashboard page publishes no separate dashboard price.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Agent 365 Dashboard" "price" "licensing"'; read the complete Agent Dashboard page and its Licensing requirements section. It names Copilot and Agent 365 licenses but no separate dashboard price.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 Global Administrators can manage all settings on the cited settings page.

claims.claim: The Agent Dashboard policy UI is under Settings > Microsoft Viva > Viva Insights > Set up and management > Access Management > Turn Advanced Insights on or off > Feature access management > Agent Dashboard > Add policy.
claims.quote: Go to the Settings tab and select Microsoft Viva, then Viva Insights. ... Set up and management ... Under Access Management, select Turn Advanced Insights on or off. On the Feature access management page, select Agent Dashboard and Add policy.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId AgentDashboard -Name DisableFeatureForAll -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone creates a tenant-wide dashboard-disable policy.
claims.quote: Example: Turn off the Agent Dashboard for all users in your tenant ... ModuleId : VivaInsights ... FeatureId : AgentDashboard ... Name : DisableFeatureForAll ... IsFeatureEnabled : false ... Everyone

claims.claim: The printed Users > Add route grants individual users access through Settings > Microsoft Viva > Viva Insights > Set up and management > Microsoft Copilot Dashboard > Manage access settings for Microsoft Copilot Dashboard.
claims.quote: Under Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, select Manage access settings for Microsoft Copilot Dashboard. ... At the top, select Users. ... To enable access for new groups: ... At the top, select Groups.
claims.fix: Change controls[1].note and the rendered note to: 'The printed Users route adds individual users; select Groups instead of Users to add groups. Turning the web app control off disables the whole app, not just the Agent Dashboard.' The printed path itself is correct.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId "Viva Insights web app" -Name DisableFeatureForAll -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone disables the web app tenant-wide.
claims.quote: Example: Turn off the Viva Insights web app for all users in your tenant ... ModuleId : VivaInsights ... FeatureId : Viva Insights web app ... Name : DisableFeatureForAll ... IsFeatureEnabled : false ... Everyone

claims.claim: A specific admin-center route for non-public-agent visibility is not documented at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Viva Insights Agent365DashboardNonPublicAgentsVisibility admin center UI policy'; opened the settings, VFAM and admin-center policy pages. The feature-specific section supplies PowerShell properties; the generic UI page does not name this feature or its UI label.

claims.where: controls[2].api; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls: third row
claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId Agent365DashboardNonPublicAgentsVisibility -Name <policy name> -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone excludes non-public agents tenant-wide.
claims.quote: Example: Exclude non-public agents from Agent 365 Dashboard view reporting ... ModuleId : VivaInsights ... FeatureId : Agent365DashboardNonPublicAgentsVisibility ... IsFeatureEnabled : false

claims.claim: Non-public agents have creator type Your org or user; public agents are created by Microsoft and third parties.
claims.quote: Non-public agents include agents with a creator type of Your org or user, and might not be available to all users in your organization. Public agents include those created by Microsoft and third parties.

claims.claim: Agent Dashboard availability and non-public-agent reporting policies support tenant, group and user scope.
claims.quote: The AI admin can enable or disable the Agent Dashboard at the tenant, group, or user level ... Similar to the Agent Dashboard on/off control, the AI admin can change this control at the tenant, group, or user level.

claims.claim: For tenants without Viva Insights licenses, minimum group size is at Settings > Microsoft Viva > Microsoft Viva Insights > Copilot Dashboard in Microsoft 365 > Manage minimum group size.
claims.quote: If your tenant does not have a Viva Insights license ... go to the Settings tab and select Microsoft Viva, then Microsoft Viva Insights. ... Under Copilot Dashboard in Microsoft 365, select Manage minimum group size.

claims.claim: No programmatic setting for dashboard minimum group size is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Viva Insights Agent Dashboard minimum group size PowerShell Graph API privacy settings', '"minimum group size" "Set-" "Insights"', '"minimum group size" "Graph" "Viva"', and PowerShell reference search; read settings and privacy pages; found UI only.

claims.claim: With Viva Insights licensing, a Viva Insights Administrator uses the privacy settings page for minimum group size instead.
claims.quote: Or, if your tenant has a Viva Insights license and you're a Viva Insights Administrator, use these steps to change the minimum group size.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Governance controls, first paragraph after table
claims.claim: Turning off the web app control disables the whole app, including the Copilot Dashboard, Copilot Analytics reports and advanced analysis tools.
claims.quote: Turning this control off disables the entire app, which includes the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, Copilot Analytics reports, and advanced analysis and admin tools.

claims.claim: VFAM access-policy changes take effect within 24 hours unless the feature documents an exception.
claims.quote: Changes to access policies take effect for the user within 24 hours, unless noted for a specific feature.

claims.claim: The most restrictive policy applies whenever several policies cover a user, without a policy-scope qualification.
claims.quote: The most restrictive Policy Scope Level takes precedence first. Then within a single Policy Scope Level, the most restrictive Enablement Policy takes precedence.
claims.fix: Replace 'the most restrictive policy applies where several cover a user' with 'user or group policies take precedence over tenant policies; within the same policy scope level, the most restrictive enablement policy applies'. The cited page orders scope levels as user/group policies, tenant policy, then defaults.

claims.claim: The existing unified exclusion list hides specified employees from dashboard aggregates, including the Agent Dashboard.
claims.quote: Create a unified exclusion list for the Copilot Dashboard, Agent Dashboard, Consumption Dashboard, and Viva Insights (hide users from aggregates) ... The user exclusion list allows admins to specify which employees' data should not be shown

claims.where: Governance guidance: After rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The checklist instructs readers to review VFAM policy change logs, but the controls table has no monitoring row.
claims.quote: After rollout: 'Review policy creation, update and deletion history ... in Microsoft Purview.' The four controls rows cover dashboard availability, web app availability, non-public-agent visibility and minimum group size, not change logs.
claims.fix: The After rollout step 'Review policy creation, update and deletion history in the Viva Feature Access Management change logs in Microsoft Purview' has no corresponding controls-table row. Remove that checklist step to resolve the mismatch without adding an unverified control row.
